justification: Inspected src/main/java/org/apache/commons/io/filefilter/SymbolicLinkFileFilter.java and src/test/java/org/apache/commons/io/filefilter/SymbolicLinkFileFilterTest.java. The class is very small and focused: it has one singleton field, two constructors, two accept overrides, and one package-private helper that delegates directly to Files.isSymbolicLink(Path). Its behavior is a single responsibility, symbol-link detection, with no evidence of multiple cohesive concerns, large method count, or low cohesion that would suggest insufficient modularization.
